CREATE PROCEDURE gold.sp_RebuildGoldHourly
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    INSERT INTO gold.crypto_candles_reporting
    (
        "Trading Pair",
        "Hour Started At",
        "Trade Date On",
        "Open Price",
        "High Price",
        "Low Price",
        "Close Price",
        "Volume"
    )
    SELECT
        d.trading_pair,
        d.hour_ts,
        d.trade_date,
        MAX(CASE WHEN d.rn_open  = 1 THEN d.open_price  END) AS open_price,
        MAX(d.high_price) AS high_price,
        MIN(d.low_price) AS low_price,
        MAX(CASE WHEN d.rn_close = 1 THEN d.close_price END)  AS close_price,
        SUM(d.volume) AS volume
    FROM
    (
        SELECT
            sc.trading_pair,
            DATEADD(hour, DATEDIFF(hour, 0, sc.open_timestamp), 0) AS hour_ts,
            CAST(sc.open_timestamp AS date) AS trade_date,
            sc.open_timestamp,
            sc.open_price,
            sc.close_price,
            sc.high_price,
            sc.low_price,
            sc.volume,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER
            (
                PARTITION BY sc.trading_pair,
                             DATEADD(hour, DATEDIFF(hour, 0, sc.open_timestamp), 0)
                ORDER BY sc.open_timestamp ASC
            ) AS rn_open,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER
            (
                PARTITION BY sc.trading_pair,
                             DATEADD(hour, DATEDIFF(hour, 0, sc.open_timestamp), 0)
                ORDER BY sc.open_timestamp DESC
            ) AS rn_close
        FROM silver.crypto_candles sc
    ) d
    GROUP BY
        d.trading_pair,
        d.hour_ts,
        d.trade_date;
END;
GO
